files.title: File:Jacoby House Columbia Franklin CMHD.jpg
files.author: Smallbones
files.caption: J.F. Jacoby House in Cape May Historic District, at corner of  Columbia and Franklin, Cape May, New Jersey. Built 1899-1900. Architect unknown. Builders York Bros. Now used as a Bed and Breakfast, known as the Dormer House, for the dormer windows on the roof.
